description: A glass box on the back edge of the lot, lit hard enough to read a map by from the road. Two short aisles, a coffee urn with a brown ring baked permanently into its drip tray, a chiller sweating against the back wall, and a counter with the till bolted through the top of it. A card taped up by the door reads NO PUMP IS EVER BROKEN. IT IS ALWAYS THE CARD. The floor is gritty in a way mopping doesn't fix, because the grit walks back in on everybody's boots.

window.description: A glazed shopfront facing the pumps, so whoever is behind the counter can see exactly who's filling what, and roughly how much of it they intend to pay for.
window.name: the shopfront glass

name: Flash Point Convenience
